'''Ubrikkia''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] situated in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]]. Located on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] it fell under the influence of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] from nearby [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], directly constituting a part of that domain around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Ubrikkia was the site of the headquarters of the company [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] and its subsidiaries and shared its name with the ornament known as the [[Ubrikkian tail spiral ring]].

==Description==
Ubrikkia was a grimy [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Ubrikkia system/Legends|Ubrikkia system]], a part of the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]]. It constituted a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] connected Ubrikkia to the [[Blimph system/Legends|Blimph]] and [[Kwenn system/Legends|Kwenn systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Ubrikkia5kBBY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ubrikkia was a part of Hutt Space around 5000 BBY.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Ubrikkia was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]]. It was situated just outside the borders of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> but was considered around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] to be a part of the "civilized galaxy" that had been widely explored by the Republic. By that time, Ubrikkia had become a part of nearby [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which had enveloped the world while expanding [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]. During the subsequent [[4000 BBY/Legends|millennium]], however, the borders of the Hutts' territory receded [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and Ubrikkia found itself outside that dominion. The world fell under the control of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ubrikkia lay within the sphere of influence of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="EGTW" /> a state which had persisted for [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TEA" /> At the time, the Republic's [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Ubrikkia's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Ubrikkia was situated in the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Ubrikkia at some point between [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] on a mission for a Hutt employer. As part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Ubrikkia system|attacked]] and conquered the Ubrikkia system, and it remained under the control of the invaders by 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The population of Ubrikkia around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between 500 million and 1 billion.<ref name="TEA" /> The world shared its name with the jewelry item known as an [[Ubrikkian tail spiral ring]], one of which was worn by the Hutt [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Locations==
Ubrikkia was the site of the headquarters<ref name="TEA" /> and the manufacturing center<ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> of [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]],<ref name="TEA" /> also known simply as Ubrikkian,<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> and its various subsidiaries.<ref name="TEA" /> Various Ubrikkian [[Factory/Legends|factories]] manufactured such products as [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]]&mdash;both civilian and military&mdash;and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="EotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Essential_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ubrikkia was introduced in ''The Essential Atlas''.]]
Ubrikkia was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu]] article describing the creation of the map of Hutt Space for ''The Essential Atlas'', Fry related that in [[2006]], after sketching an outline for the borders of that region with a ballpoint pen and noting the few [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that previously published sources had placed on maps, he composed a list of worlds that were implied to be in Hutt Space but had not been explicitly depicted as part of the region. During that process, Fry envisioned "Ubrikkia" as the name of a world and subsequently added it to the map-in-progress in pencil.<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>

Several of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] maps included in ''The Essential Atlas''<ref name="TEA" /> and other sources<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref><ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> placed Ubrikkia in grid square Q-10, although both the Appendix section<ref name="TEA" /> and the later [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book erroneously listed its location as square R-11 instead.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ubrikkia system/Legends|Ubrikkia system]]</ref>
